sections.content: Bring the futuro simple together in a short discussion of future plans, expectations and goals. Use regular future forms for what people expect or intend to do, and combine them with familiar A2 language from earlier units. Questions can introduce the topic, while predictions and personal goals develop the answer.

items.spanish: Daniela viajará por el sur de Vietnam.
items.english: Daniela will travel around southern Vietnam.
Lauren will find a new job.

items.spanish: Kaylee ahorrará dinero para visitar España.
items.english: Kaylee will save money to visit Spain.

sections.content: Keep the full infinitive before the future ending: viajaré, trabajarás, vivirán. Do not remove the -ar, -er or -ir ending before adding the futuro simple ending.
